unusual_experiment.intervention: non-mutating comparison of two independent periodic GitHub export traces

later_repository_write.meaning: GitHub repository writes were possible from at least one path after the periodic export stall; this does not prove frank-api network/auth health.

common_cutoff_window_utc.basis: rating lane completed at 20:25:04Z; the next normally scheduled AgentZero lane at approximately 20:36:44Z is absent, followed by absence of the normally scheduled rating lane at 20:55:04Z

no_new_state.reason: The rating exporter repeatedly committed the same 12-rating / 7-up / 5-down current-state snapshot at 30-minute intervals, so lack of semantic change did not suppress scheduled exports.

global_github_outage.reason: A later repository write succeeded, but frank-api-specific network/auth state remains unobserved.

independent_dual_timer_failure.reason: Two previously stable 30-minute lanes cease across the same approximately 11m40s cutoff window.

shared_host_scheduler_or_dependency_stop.reason: The synchronized loss of both recurring evidence producers is more consistent with a shared execution-host, scheduler, power, process-supervision, filesystem, database, or local connectivity dependency than with no-new-state.

reason_failure_class_not_promoted: Supervisor requires direct host/runtime evidence before classifying TIMER_DISABLED, PROCESS_STUCK, DB_LOCKED, DISK_FULL, AUTH_FAILED, RUN_FAILED, RUN_BLOCKED, PUSH_FAILED, or shared-dependency failure.
next_exact_step: On the authorized frank-api forensic/sandbox access path, observe systemd timer/service enabled+active state and journals for both exporters plus process exit, lock/SQLite, disk/inode, git remote/push, network/auth and generation evidence BEFORE restarting or mutating product services; then emit the full AUTONOMOUS_EXPORT_LIVENESS_RECEIPT/v1.
